20261122-chemistry-g08-1.material: [M2 Uphando Lwekhemistri] Umbuzo womthamo werhasi malunga ne-Ii-athomu nee-ion. Ku-$25^\circ\text{C}$ kunye no-$1\text{ atm}$, umthamo werhasi yemolar ngu-$24.5\text{ L/mol}$. Phantsi kweemeko ezifanayo, yintoni umthamo ku-$\text{L}$ we-$0.2\text{ mol}$ yale rhasi?
20261122-chemistry-g08-1.s.s1.prompt: [M2 Uphando Lwekhemistri] Umbuzo womthamo werhasi malunga ne-Ii-athomu nee-ion. 20261122-chemistry-g08-1.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Ngokomthetho ka-Avogadro, umthamo $V = n \times V_m$.
Inyathelo 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
Inyathelo 3: Ukubala kunika u-$V = 4.90\text{ L}$.

20261122-chemistry-g08-2.title: Ii-athomu nee-ion
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Ii-athomu nee-ion ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.material: [M2 Uphando Lwekhemistri (Phambili)] Ingxaki yohlalutyo lobungakanani malunga ne-Ii-athomu nee-ion. Isisombululo se-asidi $A$ sinokusansimbi $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ kwaye isisombululo $B$ sino-$[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kaphindwe kangaphi ukuxinana kwe-ion ye-hydrogen ku-$A$ kukhulu kune-B?
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: [M2 Uphando Lwekhemistri (Phambili)] Ingxaki yohlalutyo lobungakanani malunga ne-Ii-athomu nee-ion. Isisombululo se-asidi $A$ sinokusansimbi $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ kwaye isisombululo $B$ sino-$[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kaphindwe kangaphi ukuxinana kwe-ion ye-hydrogen ku-$A$ kukhulu kune-B?
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Inyathelo 2: Umlinganiselo $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Inyathelo 3: Ukuxinana kuka-$A$ kukhulu ngokuphindwe ka-100 kune-B.
